HOOK
One number could shake the dollar this week. [ON SCREEN: US FOMC Minutes]
WHAT IT IS
US FOMC Minutes lands at 14:00 ET. The forecast is n/a, last time it was n/a. [ON SCREEN: "Forecast n/a"]
WHY IT MATTERS
This feeds straight into rate expectations, and rates drive the dollar, gold and stocks. Traders will look at it within seconds of the release, so the first move is often the biggest one of the day. [ON SCREEN: DXY chart]
WHAT TO WATCH
A print above the forecast could lift the dollar and pressure gold. A miss could do the opposite. Something close to the forecast may mean a quiet market until the next release. Also watch the revision to last month, it can change the picture. Gold was near 4,500 last week. [ON SCREEN: Gold chart]
